record.name: Somalia
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The Somali National AI Centre (SNAIC), re-launched at Somali National University in July 2026 after sitting under the communications ministry and the National Communications Authority, has a research, training and innovation remit; no evaluation or safety role is described. No national AI strategy or AI law adopted.

next_check.reason: Routine re-check on a two-year rotation of states with no reported plans.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. The retained NCA primary page describes the national AI centre's innovation, public-service, research, policy-guidance and capacity-building role. It does not assign technical evaluation of the safety of advanced models. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

related_bodies.name: Somalia National AI Center (SNAIC)
related_bodies.role: It is Somali National University's centre for AI research, education, innovation and policy. No designation to evaluate advanced models was identified in its published mission.

record.notes: Search results mention a UNESCO readiness assessment and an AI strategy consultancy under the communications ministry, not verified from a primary source. The centre's page gives no founding date.
